description: The account behind this API key: wallet balance in USD (paid and bonus separately plus the total, and bonus credit that has not expired yet), this month's top-up discount (top-ups credited this month, the current discount, the next tier and how far away it is), the per-minute limit (all keys combined, including a rate package and when it ends), this key's name and creation time, and calls and spend in the last 24 hours. Free. Check the balance before a batch of paid calls; every paid call's billing also carries balance_after_usd (what is left after it).
name: everyinfra_account
title: Check account balance and usage
